name: Grounding and Prompt Assembly
area: Owns grounding corpora, prompt assembly, prompt-budget guards, and grounding-path integrity bugs.
audit_basis: Matched queued BUG IDs against regression tests in tests/test_bug*.py.
Included previously merged no-op or patch-only lineage already applied in this workspace thread for BUG-013, BUG-124, BUG-135, and BUG-138.

items.title: Grounding assembly stops at the first oversized snippet header
Oversized grounding manifests silently disable grounding while the audit still passes
Whitespace-only blank lines are not treated as paragraph breaks in grounding corpora, so poison and clean context can collapse into one oversized paragraph
`manifest.json` source paths using Windows separators silently drop valid grounding sources on POSIX
`build_tutor_prompt()` silently re-clamps `grounding_max_snippets` to 64, so injected grounding can disagree with both config and direct grounding output
